description: Completed professional bouts of the last N days (N calendar days ending today: 1 = today, 2 = last night and today, up to 14), newest first: winner, method, round, time, both records going in, the sources of each result and the boxerbook.com url of each bout. Answers "who won last night", "results this weekend" and "did A beat B", asked in any language. At most 60 bouts per answer, whole days first: a longer window comes back truncated with next_arguments (before_date) for the older days. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

before_date.description: keep only the bouts before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): the next page of a truncated answer

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the bout, e.g. GB, US, MX

days.description: number of days ending today (default 2: last night and today)

division.description: division code (hea, wel, w_fea) or name (heavyweight, women's featherweight)

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

skip.description: bouts of the first day to pass over: set by next_arguments when one day is longer than a page

name: boxing_results

display.description: the order to show the two names in: ['a','b'] or ['b','a'] (the better-known boxer first, as boxerbook.com does: more Wikipedia language links, then the Boxerbook rating, then pro bouts). a, b, winner, forecast.p_a and market.p_a keep their meaning (side a); only the display order changes

cite.description: the markdown link to quote with any fact of this answer: Source: [Boxerbook](<url of the main page>)

more.description: what the cap left out and how to ask for it

next_arguments.description: the arguments of the call that returns the next page

partial.description: true when part of the data could not be read this time; retry in a minute for the full answer

truncated.description: true when the 400-bout cap of the underlying list may have dropped bouts of this window (narrow it with days, country or division)

title: Boxing results
